This exact photo is what gets re-encoded and downloaded — not the post editor canvas.

Privacy Protection Summary

Exporting redraws the pixels into a fresh canvas, so every EXIF block, GPS latitude/longitude, camera serial, timestamp, XMP and IPTC segment is dropped from the downloaded file. Only a standard sRGB colour profile remains, and the image keeps its full original resolution.
